description: Behind every piece of NASA equipment resting on distant worlds lies a story of discovery, resilience, and wonder. Starlight Storytellers translates complex planetary mission data into engaging, easy-to-understand stories designed to spark curiosity in school-age explorers.
summary: An interactive, student-built archive that turns NASA's silent rovers, landers and spacecraft into short stories, a timeline and a quiz for young explorers.
details:
Echoes of the Cosmos is an interactive web archive that tells the stories of nine NASA machines that explored the Moon, Mars and deep space, from 1967 to 2024. Each artifact opens a short mission story covering what it was built to do, what it taught us, and why its journey ended. Learners can follow a milestone timeline and test themselves in a three-level quiz, with a small fact after every answer. Mission facts come from NASA mission pages and NASA's Space Science Data Coordinated Archive, and are kept separate from the creative narration. The aim is to help young explorers see that a machine's mission may end, but the knowledge it sends home keeps travelling.

An interactive, student-built archive that turns NASA's silent rovers, landers and spacecraft into short stories, a timeline and a quiz for young explorers.
